rewrites.comment: SPA fallback. React Router owns /admin/mobile/experts, /admin/mobile/users, /admin/mobile/dashboard and every other client route; without this, refreshing or deep-linking any of them asks the static host for a file that does not exist and returns 404. Serve index.html and let the router resolve the path.

headers.comment: Content-addressed filenames (main.<hash>.js) — safe to cache forever.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy leaves browsers pinned to a bundle whose hashed assets are gone.

connect-src lists exactly the two APIs this console talks to: the B2B auth authority and the Mobile Admin API. 'unsafe-inline' on style-src is required by CRA's injected styles and by the inline style props this codebase uses; script-src has no 'unsafe-inline', so an injected <script> is still blocked.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://b2bapi.sentiomind.in https://api.sentiomind.in; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
